text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (It's fin'lly here! Today's the day of my debut race! This is where it all starts!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But… what if I flub this race real bad?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What happens if I'm terrible out there?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mmm? Ahhh…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh… What a rich and lovely smell…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you like some coffee, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (This is Manhattan Cafe. She's my roommate and has a real air of myst'ry about her!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow, thanks for the offer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh… but I might not be able t'finish it if it's too bitter…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Not to worry. I made it just the way you like it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly gee, it's nice and sweet! And is that vanilla I'm tast'n?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's a vanilla latte. I added milk to make it creamier.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I see! Wow, this really hits the spot…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'know… I was really anxious till a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But this coffee's settled my nerves right down! The power of caffeine sure is someth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No use gett'n cold feet now. There's nothing to it, but t'do it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Good luck out there, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks bunches! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is Yukino Bijin's debut race. After seeing her to the waiting room, I head out to check the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oooh. So this is what a racecourse looks like. It's my first time coming to one. This place is huuuge!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see Yukino in the flesh! ♪ Hey, let's grab a coffee while we watch! All right, time to go off on a little adventure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears that quite a lot of the spectators today are specifically here to see her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Why is this Yukino Bijin so popular? There's no way she's that talented…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course, there are people among the crowd who have misgivings about her… but that's just part of being in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! You're not pull'n my leg, are you? There's really a buncha people cheer'n for me?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee golly… Is this really happen'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! I don't suppose y'could get me, like, a liter of coffee, could ya?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My heart feels like it's gonna pop right outta my chest! Don't y'think coffee will help?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've gotta live up t'everyone's expectations. If I don't, I'll… I'll…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uuugh!
choice_data_list: Remember who else is out there supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's right! Mom, Dad, Mifuyu… Everyone from back home… They all cheered me on when I left…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B'sides, I've already decided there's noth'n to it but t'do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay… Ev'rything's fine! My head's back in the game!
choice_data_list: Let's take advantage of all these eyes on you!
Let's take advantage of all these eyes on you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're right! This's my big chance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make my debut race one t'remember!
